limitations.title: Severe class imbalance
limitations.detail: The attack test contains 70 original positive events among 100,892 events (approximately 0.0694%). Precision is therefore highly sensitive to false positives.
limitations.mitigation: Report precision-recall metrics, alert budgets and false-positive counts rather than accuracy alone.

limitations.title: Only 70 original positive annotations
limitations.detail: All original-positive conclusions depend on 70 edge-derived annotations. A small number of missed or mislabelled events could materially change recall estimates.
limitations.mitigation: Treat results as preliminary and seek annotation review or additional scenarios.

limitations.title: Positives concentrated in two tactics
limitations.detail: Original positives comprise 69 credentialAccess events and 1 defenceEvasion event. Detection performance for other MITRE ATT&CK tactics is not established by original labels.
limitations.mitigation: Use contextual tactics only as derived indicators and collect broader labelled scenarios.

limitations.title: Contextual labels are derived indicators
limitations.detail: The 225 contextual positives are derived from connected provenance nodes, not independent ground-truth event annotations.
limitations.mitigation: Keep original and contextual metrics separate; never present contextual recall as confirmed attack detection.

limitations.title: Repeated exploratory evaluation of Phase 2
limitations.detail: The attack-test partition has been inspected repeatedly across variants and thresholds, creating selection and overfitting risk.
limitations.mitigation: Label retrospective analyses explicitly and require independent scenario validation.

limitations.title: Limited independent generalisation evidence
limitations.detail: There is one attack scenario from one collection environment. No independent host or scenario validation exists.
limitations.mitigation: Run IV-1 on independent data before any deployment claim.

limitations.title: Single-seed experimental results
limitations.detail: Every trained configuration uses seed 42 only. Mean performance and variance are unknown.
limitations.mitigation: Complete E7 with seeds 42, 123 and 456 and report mean, standard deviation and individual outcomes.

limitations.title: Low absolute precision
limitations.detail: Even the leading E2-D model has precision of 0.805% at P99 and 2.906% at the exploratory P99.95 threshold.
limitations.mitigation: Frame output as alert prioritisation, not autonomous malware classification.

limitations.title: Potential representation ambiguity
limitations.detail: Operation-only descriptions produce exact conflicts for all 70 positives. Full provenance reduces observed conflicts but semantic ambiguity may remain.
limitations.mitigation: Investigate representation ablations and semantic nearest-neighbour baselines.

limitations.title: Token truncation
limitations.detail: The encoder limit is 256 tokens. In full provenance, 327 training, 40 validation, 30 benign-test and 283 attack-test descriptions exceed the limit.
limitations.mitigation: Study chunk-aware embeddings (E3) and report truncation rates with results.

limitations.title: Training description frequency imbalance
limitations.detail: One benign description accounts for 73.23% of training events, which can dominate the reconstruction objective.
limitations.mitigation: Use unique-description or frequency-weighted training and report the trade-offs.

limitations.title: Ablation changes formatting as well as content
limitations.detail: E5-A, E5-B and E5-C differ in text ordering, length and formatting in addition to entities and relationships.
limitations.mitigation: Interpret the ablation as an overall representation comparison, not a pure causal estimate.

limitations.title: Offline provenance graph processing
limitations.detail: The pipeline operates on pre-collected provenance logs rather than a live streaming graph. End-to-end latency is not measured.
limitations.mitigation: Do not generalise inference microbenchmarks to production throughput.

limitations.title: Inference measurements exclude preprocessing
limitations.detail: Reported events-per-second figures measure model inference only and exclude verbalisation, embedding generation and graph reconstruction.

limitations.title: Mitigation effectiveness not established
limitations.detail: No automated mitigation component has been implemented or evaluated. Detection scores cannot demonstrate response effectiveness.
limitations.mitigation: Evaluate human-reviewed mitigation recommendations separately and require analyst approval.

warnings: Static aggregate snapshot. Event-level provenance is intentionally excluded.
